description: Validate business data using one PostgreSQL SELECT, including CTEs, joins and aggregates, with optional scalar $1... parameters. Requires a separate accessMode=data_read source and a dedicated non-owner role with no elevated attributes, memberships or write privileges. Runs in an explicit read-only transaction; writes, SELECT INTO, data-modifying CTEs and multiple statements are rejected by PostgreSQL. Discover accessible relations with inspect_database_schema. Default 20 rows, maximum 100 or a stricter source limit; result data is capped at 16000 bytes without silently truncating values. Use unique column aliases, narrow projections, deterministic ORDER BY and SQL pagination when sampling.hasMore=true. Prefer a replica and aggregates: reads still load production. Output uses shared secret redaction, not comprehensive PII anonymization.
name: query_database
